author: ComplexNeko
quote: I can't believe Rockstar actually released this woke garbage, my expectations have been completely demolished. Honestly, we already knew the game was going to be bad as soon as the critics started rating it the best game ever,  It runs like crap, 30fps and below, and costs way too much for a chore simulator that has completely forgotten what the series is about. They’ve completely gutted the sandbox freedom by blocking you from killing specific groups of NPCs just so nobody gets offended. On top of that, the characters are boring, the story is slow and easily the worst in the series. You just spend the whole time getting bossed around by Lucia while playing as a complete spineless loser. They know who their fanbase is, yet they threw away all the personality for lazy writing and political ****. It’s clear Take Two just wants to ruin everything that once used to be good. Just wait another year until PC modders eventually fix all this ****.
